text: {"us_status":"not found","label_product":"GILOTRIF (afatinib tablets), for oral use","label_version_or_date":"DailyMed/FDA SPL version 20; Effective Time 2025-11-13; Revised 11/2025","label_section":"Not found in current U.S. prescribing information or patient information; searched label text for eyelash, lashes, trichiasis, and hair","quote":"","eu":"EU/EMA: Giotrif product information lists section 4.8 Eye disorders, uncommon: Aberrant eyelash growth; PRAC Jan 2025 recommended this update.","uk":"UK/MHRA: UK Giotrif SmPC section 4.8 lists Eye disorders, uncommon: Keratitis; Aberrant eyelash growth.","us_regulator":"FDA: no public FDA evaluation specific to afatinib-growth of eyelashes found in AEMS/FAERS potential-signal or Sentinel sources searched; FDA's 2026 generic-afatinib notice repeats existing Gilotrif warnings/common adverse reactions without eyelash growth.","sources":["https://www.dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda/fdaDrugXsl.cfm?setid=fd638e5e-8032-e7ca-0179-95e96ab5d387&type=display","https://www.dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=fd638e5e-8032-e7ca-0179-95e96ab5d387","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/other/new-product-information-wording-extracts-prac-recommendations-signals-adopted-13-16-january-2025-prac_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/giotrif-epar-product-information_en.pdf","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/7699/smpc","https://products.mhra.gov.uk/","https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-product-information-about-medicines","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/fda-adverse-event-monitoring-system-aems/new-safety-information-or-potential-signals-serious-risks-identified-fda-adverse-event-monitoring","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-approves-first-generics-gilotrif-afatinib-tablets","https://www.sentinelinitiative.org/studies/drugs"]}
